events.title: Japanese Market Plunges 6.6%
events.description: The Japanese market is trading sharply lower on Friday, extending the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is plunging 6.6 percent to below the 57,050 level, with a sell-off across most sectors led by index heavyweights, financial and technology stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Friday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, advancing more than 125 points or 2.5 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,030-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Friday.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Overdue For Consolidation
events.description:
Hong Kong Stock Market Overdue For Consolidation
The Hong Kong stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, collecting more than 1,825 points or 7.8 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,280-point plateau although investors are likely to lock in gains on Friday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading notably lower on Friday, reversing some of the sharp gains in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 9,000 mark, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: Rally May Stall For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, accelerating more than 80 points or 2.2 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,690-point plateau although it may run out of steam on Friday.

events.title: Oversold Taiwan Stock Market Tipped To Open In The Red
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in six straight sessions, tumbling more than 5,400 points or 12.3 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 41,575-point plateau and it's expected to open under water again on Friday.

events.title: Renewed Consolidation Called For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Thursday halted the five-day losing streak in which it had slumped almost 130 points or 2.5 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just beneath the 5,300-point plateau although it may head south again on Friday.

events.title: Renewed Consolidation Tipped For Malaysia Stock Market
events.description: The Malaysia stock market bounced higher again on Thursday, one day after ending the three-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost a dozen points or 0.7 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,635-point plateau although it's likely to turn lower again on Friday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has tracked lower in four straight sessions, sinking almost 3,600 points or 5.6 percent in that span. The Nikkei now sits just beneath the 61,080-point plateau and it's got another awful lead for Friday's trade.

events.title: AI Concerns May Continue To Drag KOSPI Lower
events.description: The South Korea stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the two-day slide in which it had given up more than 280 points or 4.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,380-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Friday.

events.title: Japan Earnings Data On Tap For Friday
events.description: Japan will on Friday release September figures for average cash earnings, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Ended Nearly Flat Amid Uncertainty Surrounding U.S. Moves To Resolve Iran Conflict
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value changed a little on Thursday, as investors assessed the possible measures the U.S. administration could adopt to end the Iran crisis as oil-linked inflation is attributed to be the prime reason for setback to Republican party in the just concluded mid-term elections.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Modestly Lower After Choppy Session
events.description:
The Switzerland stock market's benchmark index SMI ended modestly lower on Thursday after a choppy session, as investors stayed a bit wary of building up positions.

Weakness in U.S. and European markets amid a sell-off in the technology sector due to concerns about AI-related investments weighed on Swiss stocks.
